ssrf_defense.controls: IPv4/IPv6 private block deny-lists, decimal/hex IP normalization, cloud metadata blocking, DNS pre-resolution, redirect re-validation

authentication.controls: JWT with HS256, 7-day expiration, bcrypt password hashing with salt cost 10, strict token validation middleware

authorization_idor.controls: Direct resource ID ownership checks on scan deletion and private history endpoints; User B cannot access/delete User A scans

rate_limiting.controls: express-rate-limit configured: scanRateLimiter (30 req/min), authRateLimiter (10 req/15min)

xss_prevention.controls: React DOM text node auto-escaping + Cheerio static parsing without executing script tags

sql_injection_defense.controls: All SQLite queries parameterized using better-sqlite3 prepare().run() and prepare().get()

security_headers.controls: Helmet middleware active (X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Strict-Transport-Security, Referrer-Policy)

upload_security.controls: Multer file size limit 5MB, MIME type filtering (image/png, image/jpeg, image/webp)

secrets_exposure.controls: Zero hardcoded production secrets in repository; environment variable injection via .env
